D-COLLISION. The trigger point is REGISTRATION = the device waking: BaseShim._ensure_device calls the new staticmethod BaseShim._register(device) after _start_device and BEFORE setting _device/presence ONLINE/capturing a snapshot. _register raises RootVerbCollision(ValueError) when (a) a declared VIEW folds onto a root view — message exactly "device view 'status' collides with the root view" (same wording the b41b proof pins) — or (b) a declared BUS VERB folds onto a root verb and its handler is not the device's own _handle_<verb> method — message "device verb 'get' collides with the root verb — <meaning>; a device keeps the root meaning through _handle_get, never rebinds the word". Keeping or overriding _handle_show/_handle_get is legal; extending declared_verbs with **super() plus new verbs is legal; a device that wakes to None registers nothing. BaseShim.resolve catches RootVerbCollision as exit 2 with the message on stderr; the old resolve-time view-collision check is REMOVED (one mouth). deliver() reaches the same refusal through _ensure_device.

D-COLLISION-LOGIC. Detection is on the DICTS the device returns, at registration, in BaseShim._register(device) (shim.py 905-929): (a) for every key of device.declared_views(): canon(key, ROOT_VIEWS) folds the key through system_word and returns the root view it matches or None; a match raises RootVerbCollision('device view <root> collides with the root view'). (b) for every (verb, handler) in device.declared_verbs().items(): root = canon(verb, ROOT_VERBS); None → skip; else the collision is 'handler != getattr(device, "_handle_" + root, None)' — i.e. the VALUE bound to the root word must be the device's own bound method _handle_<root> (the base contract BaseDevice supplies for show/get); any other callable rebinds the word and raises RootVerbCollision('device verb <root> collides with the root verb — <meaning>; ...'). No runtime method lookup, no name-string comparison of handlers: it is dict keys folded by canon, and dict values compared by equality against the one permitted bound method. _register is called from _ensure_device at every wake; the shim catches RootVerbCollision at line 957 and exits 2 with the message on stderr, stdout empty, presence unchanged, no snapshot written.

D-RESPONSE-CONTRACT. Stated once, for every tooth: BaseShim.resolve(argv: list[str]) -> dict with exactly four keys — exit (int, 0 ok / 2 refused), text (str, the human rendering), data (the JSON half, dict or None), cached (bool, True when answered cold from the snapshot/contract). cli_main(shim_cls, argv) calls resolve, prints text to stdout, and exits with exit; --data mode in the proof's driver prints json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True) instead.
